sources.title: A subexponential-time quantum algorithm for the dihedral hidden subgroup problem
sources.author: Greg Kuperberg
sources.inspected: Section3, page2: binary parity recovery reduces recursively to a subgroup isomorphic to D_(N/2), conditional on knowing the correct parity.
